en: Dependent on a wholesome state that is not a root but has roots, there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor a root nor with roots, by way of root condition.
Dependent on a wholesome state that is not a root but has roots, there arises a state that is unwholesome, not a root, and not with roots, by way of root condition.
Dependent on a wholesome state that is not a root but has roots, there arises a state that is neither wholesome...
States that are neither-root nor rootless, and states that are neither-unwholesome nor root nor rootless, arise by way of root-condition … three.
Unwholesome states that are not-root but with-root … three.

Dependent on an indeterminate state that is not-root but with-root, there arise states that are not-wholesome … pe … not-unwholesome … pe … states that are neither-wholesome-nor-unwholesome and neither-root-nor-rootless, and states that are neither-unwholesome-nor-unwholesome and neither-root-nor-rootless, arise by way of root-condition … three.

In the case of the root condition (*hetu*), there are nine; ... pe ... in the case of the mutuality condition (*aññamañña*), three; ... pe ... in the case of the ripening condition (*vipāka*), three; ... pe ... in the case of the non-disappearance condition (*avigata*), nine.
Dependent on a neutral (*abyākata*) state that is neither-root and rootless, a wholesome (*kusala*) state that is neither-root and rootless arises by way of the root condition (*hetupaccaya*).
Dependent on a neutral state that is neither-root and rootless, an unwholesome (*akusala*) state that is neither-root and rootless [arises].

A state arises by way of root condition. Dependent on an indeterminate state that is neither-root nor rootless, there arise states that are neither-wholesome-nor-root nor rootless and neither-unwholesome-nor-root nor rootless by way of root condition. Under root [condition] there are three; ...
pe ... under non-disappearance there are three.
The Section on Reasons is finished.
